hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_input.skill // empty' | { read -r s; case "$s" in jira-create-error|jira-create-imprv) echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PostToolUse","additionalContext":"jira-create-error/jira-create-imprv pair with jira-final-check.
